title: Auth email brand kit
summary: Account security emails for MyAPES Account now share one branded layout (logo, footer, Help link, UK tone). Verify-email, password-reset, and password-changed messages use the kit; further security-event templates are ready for later Account security work.
changes: Add a shared auth mail layout under resources/views/mail/auth/ with MyAPES Account branding and a Help footer link.
Ship queued verify-email, password-reset, and password-changed notifications, and stub templates for authenticator, passkey, and email-change events.
Route User email verification and password-reset notifications through the brand kit; subjects and from-name use MyAPES Account.
Add en_GB mail copy and feature tests that assert delivery and render smoke without secrets in subjects.
version_rationale: Minor bump opens the v0.39.x Account security line with the shared auth email brand kit that later MFA, passkey, and email-change work will reuse.
validation: php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
known_limitations: Password-changed mail is available in the kit but is not yet fired from profile change or guest reset (follows in password-policy work).
Authenticator, passkey, and email-change notifications are stubs until those Account security waves land.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. Auth emails return to the framework default verify/reset templates; no database migrations are included in this release.
